messages:
maya: heads-up — starting visibility provisioning for the new eu-central-3 GPU cluster. want a quick pass on the checklist before we hand off to oncall. target window: Fri 03:00-05:00 UTC

sam: +1. can you paste the minimal smoke steps? i’ll run them in staging first. :white_check_mark:

maya: plan is: 1) deploy fluentd config + s3 sink 2) prometheus scrape config + Alertmanager templates 3) jaeger collector + OTEL gateway 4) grafana dashboards + datasource 5) set retention & cost guardrails

li: adding the runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/visibility-provisioning (see section "eu-central-3 specifics") — note the NAT gateway limits in that region, you need the subnet mapping step.

ryan: cost note: we should cap logs to 7d hot ingestion and tier older to cheaper bucket. last time we forgot and S3 put costs spiked. propose a k8s-side filtering rule: drop debug logs from gpu-init pods.

sam: agree. sample fluentd filter i use:
```
<filter kube.var.log.containers>
  @type grep
  <regexp>
    key message
    pattern ^(?!.*DEBUG).*
  </regexp>
</filter>
```

maya: adding prometheus: scrape interval 30s for infra metrics, 15s for node exporters in GPU pools. prometheus server in dedicated namespace with pv/csi storage class `fast-ssd`

li: Alertmanager templates attached in that runbook but callouts: OOMKilled on model pods, GPU memory pressure > 85% for 5m, node disk IO high (> 90% for 10m). Use severity: critical for node-level, warning for pod-level.

ryan: for dashboards, use the exported JSON uid: 'rw-euc3-gpu-overview' — import with `grafana-cli --server $GRAFANA_URL dashboard import <file>` or use grafana API POST /api/dashboards/db. also include a quick link to the cluster cost dashboard.

maya: infra-bot — can you kick a smoke deploy to staging with the fluentd + prometheus manifests?

infra-bot: deploy triggered by @maya: CI pipeline `infra/visibility/eu-c3` started. build 485. status: running. :gear:

sam: when infra-bot finishes i’ll run `kubectl get pods -n observability -o wide` and drop the smoke checklist here.

ryan: one more operational thing — set a temporary rate limit on ingestion: `max_batch_size: 500` and `max_concurrent_requests: 50` for the next 48h, revisit after smoke. saves us from storms.

maya: noted. i’ll add a line in the handoff doc for oncall: contact paging list, escalation matrix, and the rollback command: `kubectl -n observability rollout undo deployment prometheus --to-revision=1`

sam: infra-bot build 485 succeeded. pushing manifests to eu-central-3 staging. smoke checks inbound. :thumbsup:

ryan: running smoke now — grep logs, check prometheus targets, query `up{job="node_exporter"}` and `sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[1m])) by (node)`. will post quick results.

maya: perfect — once sam posts smoke results i’ll finalize the handoff and add the alert templates to the alerting repo. thanks all. :pray:
